name: chronomancer-aeon-rend-owned-rank-12287
contract: Aeon Rend 583248: "Your Chromatic Shard now has a 25% chance to strike again and incur no cooldown." The
re-strike is the Chromatic Shard that hit. Its aura42 effect names rank one 801292, so a Chronomancer who owns
rank nine 567544 (level 60) re-struck with the rank one base damage.
The character owns only rank nine and Aeon Rend. Eighty ordinary rank nine casts hit the stationary Dig Rat;
a native spell modifier removes the 3500 ms cast time and Incarnation of Chaos 504723 removes the cooldown, so
only the cast cadence changes. The original 25 percent chance stays: (0.75)^80 is below 1.1e-10.
Every re-strike must be rank nine: no 801292 cast at all, and more rank nine casts and hits than ordinary casts.
